title: Column: Tin breaks higher as Indonesia cracks down on illegal miners
body: The tin market is once again bubbling on supply chain trouble, this time in Indonesia.

title: Indonesia expects deal soon with Freeport-McMoRan on divestment plan
body: Last week, Freeport declared force majeure at Grasberg after torrential mudslides that killed two workers.

title: Freeport-McMoRan still in talks with Indonesia over Grasberg mine rights
body: PT Freeport Indonesia is 51% owned by Indonesia's government but operated by Freeport.

title: Freeport to divest 12% of mine to Indonesia, CNBC says
body: The divestment is part of an agreement to extend the company’s license to operate the Grasberg mine.

title: Indonesia halts Grasberg operations to search for trapped workers
body: Two workers have died and five remain missing following a large mudflow earlier this month.

title: Freeport mine setback risks fraying relations with Indonesia
body: Grasberg has long been a flashpoint as Jakarta tries to gain a greater say over its resources.

title: Merdeka Gold shares jump by limit after Indonesia’s biggest IPO
body: Merdeka raised 4.66 trillion rupiah ($281 million) by selling a 10% stake in the IPO.

title: Antam Posts 240% Profit Surge in 1H 2025, Driven by Nickel and Gold Sales, Strengthens ESG Commitment
body: PT Antam’s first‑half 2025 net profit jumped 240% to Rp5.14 trillion, largely from a Rp3.53 trillion nickel profit and a 163% rise in gold sales to Rp49.54 trillion, while nickel production climbed 117% to 9.10 Mt and sales hit Rp7.87 trillion. The company also advanced its ESG roadmap—cutting scope 1/2 emissions by 15.8% and boosting renewable energy by 10% by 2030—while continuing bauxite smelter development and achieving over 75% land rehabilitation.”}
